subject: SOC2 re-attestation, retention window uplift and seat expansion
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <security@acme-pay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@acme-pay.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation + retention window question (renewal)

Hi Hannah,

As we move toward our renewal, our security team needs to confirm a couple of items for Acme Payments' SOC2 re-attestation: 1) the retention window for audit logs (we're proposing 18 months for our auditors), and 2) how you intend to deliver the historical evidence bundle (logs, access matrices, config snapshots).

We’re also evaluating a capacity/seat uplift for Q4 — likely +50 seats and a request for dedicated pool capacity for peak payroll runs. Before procurement drafts the PO, can you:
- confirm whether Redwood can extend log retention to 18 months for our org (and what that costs),
- propose an evidence-handling workflow (do you provide packaged evidence or do we pull from S3?), and
- provide an amendment draft (term/seat changes + retention) so Procurement can start an internal review.

Timeline: auditors want a snapshot of controls and logs by 2026-09-03. Is that feasible?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Senior Security Manager, Acme Payments

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <security@acme-pay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@acme-pay.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + retention window question (renewal)

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. TL;DR: yes, we can support 18 months retention and we’ll provide a packaged evidence handoff. Proposed plan below.

Plan (high level):
- Retention: enable org-level audit log retention to 18 months. This is a configuration flag plus storage uplift; estimate incremental monthly cost in the amendment.
- Evidence handoff: we can deliver a time-bound evidence bundle in two ways: 1) we stage a read-only S3 export (presigned links) containing the requested artifacts, or 2) we produce a packaged audit bundle (tar.gz) and provide transfer via SFTP. We recommend the S3 presigned approach for faster verification.
- Delegated uploads: if Acme prefers to collect additional telemetry, we can create an upload bucket with scoped credentials; uploads will be included in the final bundle.

Artifacts we’ll include in the bundle: list of changes since last attestation, audit_log_YYYYMM.tar (application-level logs), access_matrix.csv, config_snapshots/, and the retention policy export. See attached manifest (soc2-upload-manifest.xlsx).

Attachments: soc2-upload-manifest.xlsx (artifact checklist).

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben will send a one-page amendment draft with pricing for +50 seats and 18-month retention.
2) We provision a temporary S3 bucket and post presigned URLs for you to pull; we’ll also include the packaged tar for auditors.
3) Sign amendment via DocuSign so billing/procurement can align the PO.

Can your team confirm which evidence transfer method you prefer by EOD tomorrow? We can start the export as soon as the method is confirmed.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Customer Security Programs | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <security@acme-pay.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@acme-pay.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 14:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + retention window question (renewal)

Jordan / team — copying next steps on the commercial side.

Summary of proposed commercial changes (amendment):
- Seats: +50 developer seats (annual billing) — list price $84,000/yr; with renewal credit we can offer $72,000/yr (15% renewal uplift credit).
- Retention: 18-month audit log retention add-on — $3,500/month incremental (covers storage + archival processing).
- Capacity: dedicated burst pool for payroll windows: additional reserved capacity of 2 x p4d instances during 8-10pm PT payroll windows at $6,000/mo.

I’ve attached the amendment draft (redwood-retention-amendment-draft.pdf) and a short pricing scorecard. If these numbers look OK to Acme, we’ll issue DocuSign and lock the amendment, then coordinate schedule for the evidence export.

Proposed schedule:
- Tue 8/17: Acme confirms evidence transfer method + returns signed amendment via DocuSign.
- Wed 8/18: we provision S3 export and post presigned links; security can pull/test.
- Fri 8/20: final packaged tar delivered for auditor.

If procurement needs alternative phrasing for the PO, attach a procurement-ready line item (acme-procurement-po-draft.pdf).

— Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-retention-amendment-draft.pdf]

From: Jordan Ellis <security@acme-pay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@acme-pay.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + retention window question (renewal)

Hi Hannah / Ben — thanks, that all looks reasonable and aligns with what the audit team requested. A few clarifications before we sign:
- We prefer the S3 presigned link approach. Can you confirm objects will be immutable (read-only) and accessible for 7 days once posted?
- For delegated uploads, please scope the bucket to a single path and supply scoped credentials; we will coordinate with our SRE to upload supplemental traces.
- The procurement team asked for a one-line amendment describing the retention change (18 months) and the seat uplift so they can attach to the PO. Ben, the draft amendment looks good — please route the DocuSign to procure@acme-pay.com and to my security alias.

If you can provision the S3 exports on Wed 8/18 and send the DocuSign now, we’ll target pulling the export on Thu 8/19 and hand the bundle to auditors on Fri 8/20. That meets our internal timeline.

Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Senior Security Manager, Acme Payments
[Attachment: procurement-notes.pdf]
